public_summary: Context-envelope completion for Qwen3.5-9B Q8_0 (text-only) on an RTX 5070 12GB under llama.cpp at the corrected WELP near-full occupancy standard. Native maximum 262,144 is a completed FIT_LIMIT on both the f16 primary surface (arithmetic lower bound) and a pre-authorized q4_0-KV alternate surface (measured compute-buffer admission failure); the official YaRN 1,010,000 extension maximum is FIT_LIMIT at every representable KV precision with the mechanism representation confirmed. Highest measured/admitted near-full primary context is 65,536 (98,304 projected below the frozen safety floor and not launched). At 99.49-99.56% occupancy the planted-target retrieval is perfect (20/20 values, 4 requests, 20 observations) and synthesis/checksum instructions are retained (unlike the same-family 4B control), but the strict useful-context gate FAILED 0/4: the absent-information value (correct) is emitted under the wrong key name. Practical profile unchanged: 32K default, 64K guarded; READY_WITH_GUARDRAILS; LocalMaxxing record VERIFIED_EXISTING with no new benchmark or submission.
